stem: Which sentence from the selection best shows that Catchings cares about other people?

options.label: A
options.text: Catchings always sat up front and stayed after class to ask questions about the lessons.

options.label: B
options.text: During her four years at the university, the Lady Vols had an overall record of 134 wins and only 10 losses, partly because of Catchings’s outstanding play.

options.label: C
options.text: Most importantly, she combines her love for basketball with her passion for helping children achieve their dreams.

options.label: D
options.text: She strongly believes—and is living proof—that working hard and having confidence can help anyone succeed.
